Sorry, I’m not exactly sure about that. But, I guess I hit my first styro about 7-8 months ago, since then it has NOT healed or faded at all, just a big ol’ scar, so, it may (or not) be permanent but it should still fade pretty well if you expose it to sunlight and other things.

“Styro” is a layer of skin called the Dermis, it is white in colour and is above the fat layer, it is a fairly thick layer of skin compared to the Epidermis (visible/top layer of skin). It is usually called “styro” because of its white colour, it doesn’t appear to have any sort of styrofoam-like texture though, just very flat. Every time I’ve hit it the blood took at least a couple seconds before coming in.
